title: Garnet is writing jokes

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I've been running a little side hustle. You know that comedian Pilk Dane?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been running a little side hustle. You know that comedian Pilk Dane?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I could do that. I could write jokes. I mean, I make jokes ALL THE TIME. Mainly for my daughter to be honest, but she says I'm funny.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could do that. I could write jokes. I mean, I make jokes ALL THE TIME. Mainly for my daughter to be honest, but she says I'm funny.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I'm sure it's better than the taxi service. I'm thinking of switching careers. Delivery driver or elevator operator or... anything else I guess. Money is TIGHT.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure it's better than the taxi service. I'm thinking of switching careers. Delivery driver or elevator operator or... anything else I guess. Money is TIGHT.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: If a passenger works for a Corp and says a journey is essential to facilitate commerce, we can't charge them. New rule from the Corporate Council.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If a passenger works for a Corp and says a journey is essential to facilitate commerce, we can't charge them. New rule from the Corporate Council.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I've heard of him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I've heard of him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I've heard of him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I've heard of him.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: He's a comedian that I picked up for a hire last week. He was performing at "The Laughter Loft" downtown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a comedian that I picked up for a hire last week. He was performing at "The Laughter Loft" downtown.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I mean she mostly just rolls her eyes at me. But sometimes - just sometimes - I can still get her to crack and giggle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean she mostly just rolls her eyes at me. But sometimes - just sometimes - I can still get her to crack and giggle.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: The one that made her laugh? It's dumb. You sure you want to hear it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The one that made her laugh? It's dumb. You sure you want to hear it?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I got a daughter. Her name? Anna. I like drums a lot, so you can probably guess what I would name a second daughter...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got a daughter. Her name? Anna. I like drums a lot, so you can probably guess what I would name a second daughter...

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Ah, can't say I blame ya. Mila doesn't think I'm funny neither.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, can't say I blame ya. Mila doesn't think I'm funny neither.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Don't interrupt! Anyway, want to know what I'd call a second daughter? Anna. Yeah, I'd call them both Anna... Anna 1 Anna 2!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't interrupt! Anyway, want to know what I'd call a second daughter? Anna. Yeah, I'd call them both Anna... Anna 1 Anna 2!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Look, I gotta get out of here. I'm already late for my shift. But thanks for the chat. Most of my passengers, they don't even talk to me no more. So this was... nice. Stay loose pal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I gotta get out of here. I'm already late for my shift. But thanks for the chat. Most of my passengers, they don't even talk to me no more. So this was... nice. Stay loose pal.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I have no idea if he's successful, but when I heard his act - which he performed for me IN FULL while driving him there - I had a thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no idea if he's successful, but when I heard his act - which he performed for me IN FULL while driving him there - I had a thought.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope it was good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope it was good one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope it was good one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope it was good one.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I figure if I can make a surly teen daughter laugh, I can make ANYONE laugh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I figure if I can make a surly teen daughter laugh, I can make ANYONE laugh.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, why not. You can try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, why not. You can try.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure, why not. You can try.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure, why not. You can try.
